images.title: A square card's shadow is a rhombus
images.purpose: Shows a square card with 10 cm diagonals tilted in sunlight about one diagonal, casting a rhombus shadow with diagonals 10 cm and 6 cm whose opposite sides stay parallel.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Before and after in one row: the square card on the left, a thick grey arrow, its shadow on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: a square standing on a corner (diagonals horizontal and vertical), each diagonal 10 units, filled teal #0072B2 with thin dark outline; both diagonals drawn as thin dashed grey lines; the horizontal one labelled '10 cm' and the vertical one labelled '10 cm'. Under it: 'card'. Centre: a thick grey arrow pointing right. Right: a rhombus with a horizontal diagonal of 10 units and a vertical diagonal of 6 units, filled amber #E69F00 with thin dark outline; diagonals drawn as thin dashed grey lines, horizontal labelled '10 cm', vertical labelled '6 cm'; its upper right side labelled 'about 5.83 cm'. On both shapes, each pair of opposite sides carries matching reddish purple #CC79A7 parallel marks: single arrowheads on one pair, double arrowheads on the other. Under the rhombus: 'shadow'. So '10 cm' appears 3 times. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Parallel sides cast parallel shadows, so the square's shadow is a rhombus with sides of about 5.83 cm.
images.description: Shows a square card with 10 cm diagonals tilted in sunlight about one diagonal, casting a rhombus shadow with diagonals 10 cm and 6 cm whose opposite sides stay parallel.
images.context: Concept T12.C2; one image that shows only the main idea.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a shape change under projection; the card beside its shadow with parallel marks shows what stays.
